answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments coupled with sequential delay functions ensure identity unforgeability by binding agent state to a temporal vault of computational work. This ivory tower of security leverages VRF sortition to prevent Sybil attacks, ensuring that an orchard of cloned identities cannot spoof the recursive proofs. Such cryptographic finality guarantees BFT consensus, rendering the cost of identity spoofing information-theoretically prohibitive.
